en_title: Doom Developer id Software Confirms Work on New Game, Will Be Directed by Hugo Martin
cn_title: 《毁灭战士》开发商id Software确认正在开发新游戏，将由Hugo Martin执导
opus_summary: id Software在XBOX周年庆活动上确认正在开发新游戏，由德克萨斯和法兰克福团队合作，Hugo Martin再次担任游戏总监。工作室表示，距离公布更多消息还有一段时间。《毁灭战士：黑暗时代》的Slaughter Mode将于11月16日推出。

paragraphs.en: At Xbox's 25th anniversary celebration at its Fan Fest event in Seattle, id Software confirmed that it is working on a new game, wrapping up last year's Doom: The Dark Ages with the release of the upcoming Slaughter Mode on November 16.
paragraphs.cn: 在西雅图举行的XBOX Fan Fest活动上的XBOX 25周年庆典中，id Software确认正在开发一款新游戏，并将随着即将在11月16日推出的Slaughter Mode，为去年的《毁灭战士：黑暗时代》画上句号。

paragraphs.en: Xbox CEO Asha Sharma made the announcement on her X account, posting , "Few studios have shaped the first-person shooter genre as much as id Software. Slaughter Mode comes to DOOM: The Dark Ages | Revelations on November 16, and the team is already working on its next game." id itself also posted , saying, "We're incredibly excited about our next project, a new game from our teams in Texas and Frankfurt, with game direction once again by Hugo Martin. It'll be some time before we're ready to share more but we can't wait for you to see what we're working on."
paragraphs.cn: XBOX首席执行官Asha Sharma在她的X账号上宣布了这一消息，发文称：「很少有工作室像id Software一样对第一人称射击游戏这一类型产生如此大的影响。Slaughter Mode将于11月16日登陆《毁灭战士：黑暗时代 | Revelations》，而团队已经在开发下一款游戏。」id自身也发文表示：「我们对下一个项目感到无比兴奋，这是一款由我们位于德克萨斯州和法兰克福的团队开发的新游戏，再次由Hugo Martin担任游戏总监。我们还需要一些时间才能准备好分享更多信息，但我们已经迫不及待地想让大家看到我们正在开发的东西。」

paragraphs.en: Whether that next project is more Doom, or perhaps id returning to its other big franchise, Quake, remains to be seen. Or it might be neither of those and could be something new entirely. Although it's worth noting that id Software is under Xbox's Bethesda arm, and Bethesda boss Jill Braff recently told its development teams that "we are shifting from a planning model primarily centered on what's next for each independent studio to one that focuses on our strongest franchises and determining the content roadmap that best serves our players and Bethesda as a whole." So perhaps Quake or a fourth Doom game are the more likely options?
paragraphs.cn: 下一个项目究竟是更多《毁灭战士》，还是id可能回归其另一个大型系列《Quake》，仍有待观察。它也可能两者都不是，而是全新的东西。不过值得注意的是，id Software隶属于XBOX旗下的贝塞斯达，而贝塞斯达负责人Jill Braff最近告诉旗下开发团队：「我们正在从主要围绕各个独立工作室下一步计划的规划模式，转向聚焦我们最强大的系列，并确定最有利于玩家和贝塞斯达整体利益的内容路线图的模式。」因此，《Quake》或第四款《毁灭战士》游戏或许是可能性更大的选项？

paragraphs.en: That remains to be seen, but what the last decade has proven is that Martin and the id Software team are very good at what they do. Doom (2016) successfully rebooted a dormant franchise, while Doom Eternal stood on its shoulders , and then Doom: The Dark Ages brought the focus back to the ground . All three were excellent.
paragraphs.cn: 这仍有待观察，但过去十年证明，Martin和id Software团队非常擅长他们所做的事。《毁灭战士》（2016）成功重启了一个沉寂已久的系列，而《毁灭战士：永恒》站在了它的肩膀上，随后《毁灭战士：黑暗时代》又将重心带回了地面。这三款游戏都很出色。

paragraphs.en: Doom: The Dark Ages' Slaughter Mode, meanwhile, is an endless single-player mode that will be added as a free update for those who've purchased Doom: The Dark Ages - Revelations DLC, which we reviewed and loved .
paragraphs.cn: 与此同时，《毁灭战士：黑暗时代》的Slaughter Mode是一种无尽单人模式，将作为免费更新提供给购买了《毁灭战士：黑暗时代 - Revelations》DLC的玩家。我们曾评测过该DLC，并且非常喜欢。

paragraphs.en: Ryan McCaffrey is IGN's executive editor of previews and host of IGN's weekly Xbox show, Podcast Unlocked , and a co-host of Next-Gen Console Watch . He's a North Jersey guy, so it's "Taylor ham," not "pork roll." Debate it with him on Twitter at @DMC_Ryan .
paragraphs.cn: Ryan McCaffrey是IGN的前瞻内容执行编辑，也是IGN每周XBOX节目《Podcast Unlocked》的主持人，以及《Next-Gen Console Watch》的联合主持人。他是北新泽西人，所以那叫「Taylor ham」，而不是「pork roll」。可以在X上通过@DMC_Ryan与他辩论此事。
